description: This file defines utility functions for splitting a string into a linked list of tokens. It includes methods to split a string by spaces, validate tokens, and add valid tokens to the list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing functions to split strings into linked lists of tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string by spaces into a linked list of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is valid.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
